cells.question: Q01

passages.quote: the Secretary of Commerce shall require:

Companies developing or demonstrating an intent to develop potential dual-use foundation models to provide the Federal Government, on an ongoing basis, with information, reports, or records regarding the following

cells.note: The order does not itself place duties on companies; it directs the Secretary of Commerce, acting under the Defense Production Act, to require “Companies developing or demonstrating an intent to develop potential dual-use foundation models” to report. The term “dual-use foundation model” is defined in Sec. 3(k); Sec. 4.2(a)(ii) separately covers those who acquire, develop or possess a potential large-scale computing cluster.

cells.note: An export-control rule: duties fall on exporters, reexporters and transferors of controlled items, including model weights specified in ECCN 4E091 (licence requirement in § 742.6(a)(13); conditions of License Exception AIA in § 740.27), and on Data Center Validated End Users (VEUs) under Supplement No. 10 to part 748. cells.question: Q02

passages.quote: 4E091 ‘Parameters’ for an artificial intelligence model trained utilizing
ECCN 4E091 excludes from the control any open-weight models

cells.note: The heading continues with a figure that the PDF text layer renders as “1026” before “or more ‘operations’”, read as 10^26 operations; the quote stops before it. Notes 1 and 2 to 4E091 exclude published weights, models derived from them with no more than 2.5 × 10^25 additional operations or 25 percent (whichever is higher), and models trained with fewer operations than needed to match the most advanced published model.

cells.note: Partly: the rule requires security measures, including AI-specific security practices covering model weights (para. 15), as conditions of validated end-user authorisation and, under § 740.27(a)(3)(ii), for facilities storing specified model weights. The regulated party is the validated end user or facility, not necessarily a model developer. Status applied from the cross-family check; the boundary (whether model-weight security risks count as risks of models) is raised for the maintainer.
